mapper.sql: id, operation_ip, oper_location, method, args, operation_name, operation_type, return_value, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_operation_log (operation_ip, oper_location, method, args, operation_name, operation_type, return_value) VALUES (#{operationIp}, #{operLocation}, #{method}, #{args}, #{operationName}, #{operationType}, #{returnValue})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_operation_log WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_operation_log SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE sys_operation_log SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT operation_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_operation_log GROUP BY operation_type ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT operation_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_operation_log GROUP BY operation_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_operation_log WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_operation_log WHERE YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_operation_log WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT MIN(create_time) FROM sys_operation_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{keepDays} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_operation_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{keepDays} DAY)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_operation_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{keepDays} DAY)
